welcome:
Welcome to the Helm CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated production cluster with Helm releases.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: First, add the Bitnami repository so we can pull community charts.
steps.hint: Try: helm repo add bitnami https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami

steps.instruction: Update all repo indexes to get the latest chart versions.
Install the api-chart into production with production values.
steps.hint: Try: helm install api ./api-chart --namespace production --values values-prod.yaml

steps.instruction: Check the status of the new release to verify it deployed.
List all releases in production to see the full picture.
Now upgrade the API to v2.3.0 by setting the image tag.
steps.hint: Try: helm upgrade api ./api-chart -n production --set image.tag=v2.3.0

steps.instruction: Check the revision history to confirm the upgrade was recorded.
The new version has a memory leak. Roll back to revision 2.
List all releases in production to find the problem.
The 'web' release shows status 'failed'. Get its detailed status.
Check what values the failed release was deployed with.
steps.hint: Try: helm get values web -n production

steps.instruction: Look at the rendered manifest to see what Kubernetes resources were generated.
steps.hint: Try: helm get manifest web -n production

steps.instruction: Render the template locally to debug without deploying.
Lint the chart to catch structural issues.
Use the diff plugin to preview what an upgrade would change.
steps.hint: Try: helm diff upgrade web ./web-chart -n production

steps.instruction: Fix the values and upgrade the release with the corrected chart.
steps.hint: Try: helm upgrade web ./web-chart -n production --values values-prod.yaml

commands.help:
Available commands:
  helm install [name] [chart]    — Install a Helm chart
  helm upgrade [name] [chart]    — Upgrade a release
  helm upgrade --install         — Install or upgrade
  helm rollback [name] [rev]     — Roll back to a previous revision
  helm uninstall [name]          — Remove a release
  helm list                      — List releases
  helm status [name]             — Show release status
  helm history [name]            — Show release history
  helm get values [name]         — Show release values
  helm get manifest [name]       — Show release manifest
  helm repo add/update/list      — Manage chart repos
  helm search repo [keyword]     — Search repos for charts
  helm template [name] [chart]   — Render chart templates locally
  helm create [name]             — Create a new chart scaffold
  helm package [chart]           — Package chart into archive
  helm lint [chart]              — Check chart for issues
  helm plugin list               — List installed plugins
  helm diff upgrade              — Preview upgrade changes (plugin)
  helm version                   — Show Helm version
  helm install --dry-run         — Simulate install without deploying

  scenario                       — Start a guided lab
  clear                          — Clear the terminal
  help                           — Show this help

---
# Source: api-chart/templates/serviceaccount.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: api
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: api
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: api
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "2.1.0"
    helm.sh/chart: api-chart-1.4.2
---
# Source: api-chart/templates/configmap.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: api-config
  namespace: production
data:
  DB_HOST: postgres-postgresql.production.svc.cluster.local
  DB_PORT: "5432"
  DB_NAME: production
  REDIS_HOST: redis-master.production.svc.cluster.local
---
# Source: api-chart/templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: api
  namespace: production
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
    - port: 8080
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP
      name: http
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: api
---
# Source: api-chart/templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
  namespace: production
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: api
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: api
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: "myregistry/api:v2.1.0"
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 15
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /readyz
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
            requests:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 256Mi
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: api-config
---
# Source: api-chart/templates/hpa.yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: api
  namespace: production
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: api
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 15
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 70
